name: Maintain Loop
steps: Drag the book to the ghost dog to power it up.
Tap the clock to drop a gear or clock part.
Tap the box to reveal a hidden item.
Open curtains to let in moonlight energy.
Tap the golden amulet to boost power.
Tap the hairpin to strengthen the dog.
Tap the chew toy in cabinet to collect it.
Tap the vase to gain energy.
Tap dog bowl to increase strength.
Tap welcome mat to reveal final item.
